name: Ella Town Centre
description: The compact centre along Ella's main road holds most cafes, restaurants, shops and the train station. It is the most convenient base, walkable to services and buses, and lively in the evenings with a mix of travellers and locals.
bestFor: Travellers wanting cafes, transport and walkable convenience in one spot

name: Kithal Ella
tagline: Green hills near Little Adam's Peak
description: A quieter area just southeast of town at the foot of Little Adam's Peak, dotted with guesthouses and homestays among tea fields. It offers scenic hillside stays and easy trail access while remaining a short walk or tuk-tuk from the centre.
bestFor: Hikers wanting tea-field views and quiet near the town centre

name: Nine Arch Bridge area
tagline: Iconic viaduct amid tea and jungle
description: The area around the famous Nine Arch Bridge in Demodara, surrounded by tea plantations and jungle. Guesthouses here offer views of the trains crossing the viaduct and a peaceful setting, a scenic tuk-tuk ride from Ella's centre.
bestFor: Photographers and quiet-seekers wanting the classic bridge and train views

name: Ravana / Wellawaya Road
description: The stretch southeast of town along the road toward Ravana Falls and Wellawaya, known for guesthouses with dramatic valley and Ella Gap views. It suits those wanting panoramic scenery, though most stays need a tuk-tuk into the centre.
bestFor: Visitors prioritising valley views and calm over walkable convenience
